shared_elements: circular/disc motifs (rosettes in B, concentric disc in A)
justification: Both are stone surfaces worked in shallow relief with incised curvilinear outlines and both include circular motifs and horizontal dividing bands, but that is about the limit of the correspondence. A is a bulky, weathered free-standing block with a frontal schematic head and abstract chest ornaments carved in a coarse, blunt manner, whereas B is a smooth, flat panel with a finely modelled naturalistic animal and human in profile procession framed by a neat rosette border.
